title: Zeus Juice Black Reloaded 50/50 Nic Salt E-Liquid 10ml
description: Black Reloaded takes Zeus’ signature Black e-liquid and complements the rich sweetness of ripe dark berries and sharp blackcurrants with a delicate balance of fire and ice from aniseed and menthol. This premium e-liquid’s 50VG/50PG blend offers the perfect balance between flavour and cloud production and the nic salt solution makes it ideal for use in classic e-cigarette starter vape kits and pod vape kit devices. Perfect for recent ex-smokers or vapers seeking the immediate, satisfying nicotine relief provided by nic salts.
